title: Sandiganbayan orders 90-day preventive suspension of Jinggoy Estrada anew
summary: The Sandiganbayan Fifth Division has ordered another 90-day preventive suspension of Sen. Jinggoy Estrada, as he faces a plunder charge in connection to the alleged flood control kickback scheme.
